Class CausalBufferPolicy.Builder

java.lang.Object
io.parsley.CausalBufferPolicy.Builder
Enclosing class:
CausalBufferPolicy
public static final class CausalBufferPolicy.Builder extends Object
Builder for CausalBufferPolicy. All four settings must be provided; build() throws IllegalStateException if any are missing.
